findings.evidence: All four cart lines render the auto-generated text 'Taille : 1 viande' inside the customer-facing note slot (data-testid="kiosk-cart-item-note-0" through kiosk-cart-item-note-3 — DOM grep on 15-cart-after-add-309-310-311-314.dom.html confirms 4 occurrences). The wizard never showed a 'taille' or 'viande' step for any of these items (verified on screenshots 309/310/311/314-01 through -03 — pipeline collapses to sauce + supplements + recap, no kiosk-step-taille / kiosk-step-viande mounts in any of the 12 wizard DOMs). Trace: KioskWizardComponent.vue mounted() L2060–L2068 calls inferTacosPresetMeta() unconditionally; L1030–L1044 returns a non-null preset whenever shouldAskTacosTaille()===false (i.e., for ALL non-tacos items). It builds `label = '1 viande'` via the fallback `${viandeCount} viande${viandeCount > 1 ? 's' : ''}` (L1037) when no taille name is detected in item.name. That label is then propagated to selections._tailleMeta.label and consumed by buildInstruction() at L1945–L1947 with NO `shouldShowCompositionStep('taille')` guard — unlike compositionSummaryChips() at L653 which DOES guard. The text is then assigned to cart line `instruction` at L1930 and serialized to the backend via kioskCart.js sanitizeKioskOrderItem() L98-L112 which preserves `instruction`. Customer-facing impact: shows on cart (verified), printed on kitchen ticket, included in NF525 receipt note, prepended to any actual customer note. False-positive 'taille' info contradicts the actual order (these items have no taille step / no viande step).
findings.fix_hint: resources/js/components/frontend/kiosk/KioskWizardComponent.vue line 1945 — wrap the `if (this.selections._tailleMeta?.label)` in `&& this.shouldShowCompositionStep('taille')` to mirror the recap-chip guard at L653. Alternatively, fix the root cause at L1030–L1044: inferTacosPresetMeta() should ONLY run for tacos templates (rename appropriately) — gate via `if (effectiveWizardTemplate() !== 'tacos') return null;`. Add Vitest regression: assert buildInstruction() returns '' for an Assiette/Omelette/Ojja item with no taille step active (only sauce selected).

findings.evidence: AUDIT_PLAN.md L62-L65 explicitly mandated the cat 309 (Assiette) pipeline as `viande + sauce + garnitures + supplements + recap` and called out state 01 = '01-309-wizard-step-viande — viande selection visible; pick Poulet'. The captured pipeline for cat 309 is `sauce + supplements + recap` only — verified by screenshot 309-01-step-sauce.png + 309-02-step-supplements.png + 309-03-step-recap.png and DOM grep showing zero `.kiosk-step-viande` and zero `.kiosk-step-garnitures` mounts in any 309 DOM. The GStack agent's defense ('items lack viande/garnitures extras seeded → shouldShowStep filters them out') is product-correct — DB query `SELECT id, name FROM items WHERE id IN (381,382,383,384)` returns 'Assiette Poulet / Kefta / Merguez / Mixte', i.e. each meat is a SEPARATE SKU with the meat encoded in item.name; they share zero 'Viande' attribute (only attr 311 = 'Sauce') and the 6 extras for item 381 all have price=1€ → partitionKioskExtras() routes them to `supplements` (no garnitures). However, the audit plan was therefore mis-specified, and the spec (test-e2e-borne-2026-05-10-wave-B.spec.js L287 `allowedTypes`) was relaxed silently to accept any subset — the intended verification of an 'assiette template viande+garnitures pipeline' is NOT performed. The spec should have either (a) rejected the AUDIT_PLAN expectation as catalog-mismatch and emitted a planning gap ticket, or (b) seeded a parent-SKU with viande variations to actually exercise the assiette template's viande step.
findings.fix_hint: Two-fork resolution. Fork A (recommended product-correct): reconcile AUDIT_PLAN.md to reflect 4 separate Assiette SKUs and remove the viande-step + garnitures-step expectation for cat 309. Document this in a planning addendum and update Wave B states 1-3 to be cat-309 = sauce + supplements + recap. Fork B (catalog audit): IF the owner intends Assiettes to be one parent SKU with a Viande variation attribute (Poulet/Kefta/Merguez/Mixte) AND price=0 garnitures (Tomates/Salade/Oignons), the seeder + admin migration must add those attributes/extras and the assiette template's viande step would then render. Confirm with owner which fork is intended before any code change. Until then, this is an audit-integrity blocker on the validity of Wave B (Phase D 'frites incluses' pipeline only proves NO-MENU/NO-FRITES_STYLE; it does NOT prove the assiette template renders viande+garnitures).
